test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BOXER' is written as '251224229'. How will 'PULLY' be written in that language?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**1) All alphabets opposite alphabets place value coded as number except middle alphabet.**

**2) Middle alphabet place value coded as the number.**

 'BOXER' is written as '251224229'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/49a46dd7b2d0899d6c644de42df3af6b5baa7873f8fa9f9730974d6c9f1726d8.png] 

Similarly,

'PULLY' = ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dad992c05d41d96a7d789e464a9df3efc692287bc5b4a2263b48a913197127b.png] 

Hence, 'PULLY' is coded as "**11612152**".
